payload.title: kino's archetype restates a narrower architect role
payload.body: Beside the assay of archetype-closed-plan-route of notebook-gaps at 96fa8129 (achieved). packages/canon/src/agents/kino.ts's archetype restates the architect role rather than only its residue. It names the routes (ready unit, unachieved or broken whole, achieved) and what reaches the architect (verdict, broke-the-whole, units ready to start). It omits the closed-plan route and units waiting on a route, both now in the role's contract and the generic archetype. This is the shape the ruling 'mav's cell restates its role' removed from mav; under persona, kino would declare only its residue (film craft, teaching the operator).
